title: The Resolution Hypothesis: Agent Evolution's Key Is Identifying Improvements
title_zh: 分辨率假说（Resolution Hypothesis）：智能体演化的关键是识别真正的改进
abstract_en: Agent evolution follows a simple loop: a proposer writes candidate artifacts (prompts, skills, memories) and selection accepts those that score higher. This loop has shown promise, yet practitioners face a puzzle: methods trade wins across papers, and evolution often fails to bootstrap on certain tasks. We trace this puzzle to the Resolution Hypothesis: agent evolution stalls not because methods fail to propose better artifacts, but because noisy evaluations cannot reliably identify them. Across seven evolution methods and six models (over 10M LLM calls), we find support for the hypothesis at both levels where evaluation scores are used. At the candidate level (choosing artifacts), helpful candidate artifacts exist, but selection is no better than random at telling them from harmful ones, so errors accumulate across rounds. At the method level (ranking methods), typical margins of a few percentage points are smaller than the difference between two independent runs of the same method, so published rankings often rest on luck. Together, these findings indicate that agent evolution is often bottlenecked by reliably identifying improvements. This calls for a shift in how we develop and evaluate self-improving agents, from designing ever more candidate improvement systems to making true improvements detectable and accumulable.
abstract_zh: 智能体演化遵循一个简单的循环：提议模块生成候选提示词、技能或记忆，筛选机制则接受得分更高的候选。尽管这一框架展现出潜力，不同论文中的方法排名却常常互有胜负，演化在部分任务上也难以启动。作者提出分辨率假说：瓶颈不在于生成更好的候选，而在于带噪声的评估无法可靠地识别它们。研究覆盖 7 种演化方法和 6 个模型，涉及超过 1000 万次 LLM 调用，并在两个层面发现了支持该假说的证据。在候选层面，确实存在能提升表现的候选，但筛选机制区分有益与有害候选的表现不优于随机选择，误选因而逐轮累积。在方法层面，不同方法之间常见的几个百分点的差距，小于同一方法两次独立运行之间的差异，因此已发表的排名可能受偶然性左右。作者据此建议，将研究重点从设计更多候选生成机制，转向提高评估的辨别力，让真正的改进能够被识别并逐轮积累。
key_points_zh: 实验覆盖 7 种演化方法和 6 个模型，共进行了超过 1000 万次 LLM 调用。
候选层面：有益候选确实存在，但筛选机制区分有益与有害候选的表现不优于随机选择，误选会逐轮累积。
方法层面：同一方法两次独立运行的差异可超过方法间常见的几个百分点差距，仅凭小幅领先难以得出可靠排名。
研究建议优先提升评估对真实增益的辨别力，而非一味增加生成候选的机制。

agent-harness-evolution.reason: 论文通过受控候选池和多次独立运行，检验评估噪声是否比提案质量更限制智能体演化，并给出分开评估提案器与选择器的诊断方法。
agent-harness-evolution.quote:
The Resolution Hypothesis. The bottleneck of agent evolution is identifying which artifacts bring
improvement, not proposing them.

agent-memory.reason: 方法级重复实验直接纳入了演化外部记忆手册的 ReasoningBank，可用于诊断记忆演化的评估噪声，但候选级对照只检验技能，未隔离记忆特有的机制。
agent-memory.quote:
We study seven evolution methods in two families. Four text-artifact methods evolve text given to the agent:
prompts (GEPA [2]), skills (SkillOpt-Lite [31], Trace2Skill [24]), and memory playbooks (ReasoningBank [27]).
